title: Online sales to consumers (EU)
description: Repository checks and questions for the legal and product owners when a shop or a marketplace sells to consumers in the EU: Directive 2011/83/EU on consumer rights as amended by Directives (EU) 2019/2161 and 2023/2673, Directive 98/6/EC on price indication, Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 (DSA) for online platforms and Directive (EU) 2015/2366 (PSD2) for payment authentication. Covers EU texts only; national transpositions can add rules, and card data security needs its own review. These rules do not establish compliance.

sources.title: Directive (EU) 2019/2161 on better enforcement and modernisation of Union consumer protection rules
Directive (EU) 2023/2673, withdrawal from distance contracts concluded by means of an online interface
Directive (EU) 2015/2366 on payment services in the internal market (PSD2)

rules.instruction: Label the button or function that places an order with an obligation to pay "order with obligation to pay" or an unambiguous equivalent (Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 8(2)).
rules.verification: Run the checkout test that asserts the label of the order button.

rules.instruction: Show the main characteristics of the goods or services and the total price inclusive of taxes before the consumer places the order (Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 6(1)(a) and (e)).
rules.verification: Run the checkout test that finds the characteristics and the total price on the page of the order button.

rules.instruction: Show delivery restrictions and the accepted means of payment at the latest at the beginning of the ordering process (Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 8(3)).
rules.verification: Open the first page of the ordering process and find both pieces of information.

rules.instruction: Provide, for contracts concluded through the online interface, a withdrawal function labelled "withdraw from contract here" or an unambiguous equivalent (Art. 11a of Directive 2011/83/EU, inserted by Directive (EU) 2023/2673 and applied from 19 June 2026).
rules.verification: Run the test that finds the labelled withdrawal function on a test order and completes a withdrawal.

rules.instruction: Ask the legal owner which products the 14-day withdrawal period of Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 9(1) covers and which exceptions apply, and keep the returns logic to that answer.
rules.verification: Link the recorded answer and run the test of the withdrawal deadline.

rules.instruction: When the shop announces a price reduction, show as prior price the lowest price applied during at least the 30 days before the reduction (Directive 98/6/EC Art. 6a, inserted by Directive (EU) 2019/2161).
rules.verification: Run the unit test that computes the prior price from a price history.

rules.instruction: When the product is a marketplace, tell the consumer whether the third party offering the goods or services is a trader before the contract is concluded (Directive 2011/83/EU Art. 6a(1)(b)).
rules.verification: Open a third-party offer and find the trader status.

rules.instruction: When the product is an online platform that lets traders conclude distance contracts with consumers, collect the trader information of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 Art. 30(1) before a trader can offer in the EU, and ask the legal owner whether the platform is exempt as a micro or small enterprise.
rules.verification: Run the test that refuses a trader listing without each Art. 30(1) item, or link the recorded exemption.

rules.instruction: When the product is an online platform, ask the product owner to review new checkout, subscription and cancellation screens against Regulation (EU) 2022/2065 Art. 25(1), which forbids interfaces that deceive or manipulate their users.
rules.verification: Link the recorded review of each new screen.

rules.instruction: When the checkout initiates an electronic payment, keep the strong customer authentication step that the payment service provider applies under Directive (EU) 2015/2366 Art. 97(1), and handle its challenge and its failure in the order flow.
rules.verification: Run the checkout test with the provider's test authentication challenge and check that the order waits for its result.
